name: Grilled BBQ Chicken Bowls with Black Bean-Corn Salad
description: BBQ-glazed grilled chicken thighs and grilled corn over rice with a fresh black bean-corn salad.

ingredients.notes: divided, for the salad and corn

ingredients.item: shredded smoked gouda or Monterey Jack cheese

steps.text: Combine the black beans, tomatoes, onion, cilantro, and bell pepper in a large bowl. Set aside.
Place the chicken thighs in a shallow dish and toss with avocado oil, 1/4 cup BBQ sauce, salt, and pepper.
Brush the corn with 2 tablespoons avocado oil and wrap each ear in foil.
Heat the grill to medium-high (175-200°C) and oil the grates.

Grill the chicken 4 minutes per side, then brush with the remaining 1/2 cup BBQ sauce, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook 3-5 minutes more until cooked through. Grill the foil-wrapped corn 10-12 minutes, rotating every 3 minutes. Rest the chicken 5-8 minutes, then slice into strips.
Cut the corn kernels from the cob and stir into the bean salad along with the remaining avocado oil and lime juice.
Spoon rice into bowls, top with sliced chicken and extra BBQ sauce, then the black bean-corn salad. Sprinkle with cheese, jalapeño, and cilantro.

notes: The salad can be prepped ahead and the chicken marinated the morning before grilling. Bowl components keep separately for 2-3 days for meal prep.
